# lwIP 2.2.1

The upstream sources in this directory are from `lwip-tcpip/lwip`, tag `STABLE-2_2_1_RELEASE`, commit `77dcd25a72509eb83f72b033d219b1d40cd8eb95`.

Only the public headers and the raw IPv4/TCP/UDP core files used by this port are included. Contents are unchanged from the tagged sources. See `COPYING` and the copyright notices in individual files. The OpenHC port and build configuration are outside this directory under `lwip-ipv4/`.
